object.attr: analysis: the path audit after the code view (2026-11-13) found that a load error's merge-conflict note took the start of the message as a file name, so an attribute name holding .. made every load read a file outside the repository, and a network path there would make Windows send the user's credentials to that host. MELLON-STORE-SRS-231 covers what a file refers to when it is read, drawn or exported; this covers every path a load touches, whatever names it. Accepted on 2026-11-14 by the person as a security fix (open question Q20).
object.description: When Mellon loads a document, Mellon shall access no path outside the document's folder.
